title: doppeldata bundle check report
description:
Related tables generated from a bundle, measured against it: each table against its own
profile, then each relationship's fan-out, orphan rate and busiest parents.

profile.description: The bundle the tables were generated from.

scenario.description:
The scenarios applied, named as a bundle's manifest names them, with the SHA-256 taken over
the map of each table to its scenario. Null for none.

data.description:
The data as the caller named it, and the rows of every table together. `fingerprint` is
null, as each table's report holds its own.

passed.description: Whether every table's check and every relationship metric that decides passed.

verified.description: Whether every table's scenario expectations held.

tables.description: Each table's check, every parent before its children.

relationships.description:
`fanout_ks`, `orphan_fraction_delta` and `top_fraction_delta` of each relationship, in the
bundle's order, each naming its relationship in `relationship`.

sha256.description: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of the profile's RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

path.description: The profile's path as the caller gave it, or null when it came from memory.

sha256.description:
The scenario's SHA-256, taken as a manifest's `identity.scenario_sha256` is: the SHA-256 of
its RFC 8785 canonical JSON with each perturbation's `id` resolved, and with `description`
and `expect` left out.

CheckedData.description: The data that was profiled and measured.

path.description: The data as the caller named it, such as `s3://bucket/orders/`.

fingerprint.description: The profile's `source_fingerprint` of the files read, or null for an in-memory table.

dataset_sha256.description:
The `dataset_sha256` of the manifest the check read with the data, a bundle's for a
bundle, or null where it read none.

one_file.description:
The file a write to one file put every row in, as that manifest's `one_file` records it,
or null. A check of such a write leaves `files_delta`, `rows_per_file_delta` and
`partition_fraction_delta` unmeasured, because the write chose its own layout.

name.description: The table's name in the bundle.

CheckReport.description:
Generated data measured against the profile it was generated from, by profiling the data with
that profile's histogram edges and value lists frozen.

profile.description: The profile the data was generated from.

scenario.description: The scenario applied to the profile, or null for none.

against.description: The real data the data was scored against, or null when none was named.

passed.description:
Whether every metric that decides and every column change passed. A metric the profile
states and the data cannot supply fails, because a check vouches for the data.

verified.description: Whether every declared expectation held. True when no scenario declares any.

changes.description:
Columns the data adds or drops, or holds as another kind or semantic type. A change a writer
alone causes is listed and passes: an Arrow type, which a writer may store at another width
or unit, and a decimal read back from text as a float. So does a semantic type no detector
pack both profiles ran declares.

expectations.description: The scenario's declared expectations, empty when no scenario applies.

RealData.description:
The real data a check scored the data against. The report holds its scores and none of its
rows.

path.description: The real data as the caller named it.

rows.description: The rows the real data holds.

fingerprint.description: The `source_fingerprint` of the real data's files, or null for an in-memory table.

scored_rows.description: The rows of each side's seeded sample that the scores read.

correlation.description: The coefficient `CorrelationSimilarity` compares, spelled as a profile's correlations spell it.

oneOf.description: Bias-corrected Cramér's V between two categorical columns.

MetricResult.description:
One metric's value for one column, or for a pair where `paired_with` names the second, or for
the table where `column` is null. `metric`, `column` and `paired_with` together name the row.

metric.description: The metric's name, such as `ks` or `KSComplement`, as `--thresholds` keys it.

column.description: The column, or a pair's first column in the profile's order.

paired_with.description: A pair's second column, for a score of two columns.

worst_given_value.description:
The value of `paired_with` the metric's value is worst within, for a metric of one column
given another, such as `conditional_kl`.

relationship.description:
The relationship, as `orders.customer_id → customers.customer_id`, for a metric of one
in a bundle check. `column` is then null.

value.description:
The metric's value. It is null where `unmeasured` says why the other profile cannot supply
it, where `skipped_by` names the perturbation that moves it, and where `drawn_by` names the
relationship that decides it.

bound.description: Whether `value` passes at or below `threshold`, or at or above it.

passed.description:
Whether the row counts against the report: false only on a row that decides and whose
value misses `threshold` or is unmeasured.

decides.description:
False on a row the report's verdict leaves out: a score against the real data whose
threshold no thresholds file sets, and `malformed_fraction_delta` on data written with no
`malformed_rows`. Such a row passes. A score's `threshold` is its reference, which `value`
and `bound` say whether it meets.

expected.description:
The statistic the metric compares, as the source profile holds it, or the real data for a
score against it: A's, in a diff.

observed.description: The same statistic in the data checked: B's, in a diff.

unmeasured.description:
Why the metric has no value: the source profile states what it compares, and the other
profile holds nothing to compare it with, as a column under `k_min` values holds no
quantiles. Or the data was written so as not to hold it, as clean files hold none of the
source's malformed rows.

skipped_by.description:
The id of the scenario's perturbation that moves what the metric compares, so the metric
is not measured and passes.

drawn_by.description:
In a bundle check, the relationship drawing a foreign-key column, as
`orders.customer_id → customers.customer_id`, for a metric comparing which values that column
holds, which the relationship deals out from its parent's keys. The metric is not measured
and passes.

oneOf.description: The value passes at or below the threshold.
The value passes at or above the threshold.

FieldChange.description: A field that differs between the two profiles, outside what the metrics measure.

column.description: The column the change is in, or null for a table-level field.

field.description:
An RFC 6901 pointer to the field: in the source profile, or A, for a dropped column, and in
the other profile for every other change.

expected.description: The field's value in the source profile, or A, and null where it holds none.

observed.description: The field's value in the profile of the data checked, or B, and null where it holds none.

passed.description: False when the change fails the check or counts as drift.

oneOf.description:
The column kind the profiler read the column as, from its logical type and an Arrow
decimal type.
The Arrow type, such as `int32` becoming `int64`.
More rows than the diff allows fall outside the histogram edges or value list frozen from A.

ExpectationResult.description: A scenario's declared expectation and the value the data holds.

column.description: The column measured, or null for a metric of the whole table, such as `malformed.fraction`.

value.description: The value the data holds, or null where `unmeasured` says why.

unmeasured.description: Why the data holds no value, such as a column it lacks. The expectation then fails.
